verdict.rationale: Attio's reporting page describes native reports on live data, using line charts, bar graphs and geospatial maps. It says these visualizations can be combined into dashboards, and its examples show pipeline and conversion metrics: weighted pipeline, pipeline by region, stuck deals, win rate, sales cycle and stage conversion. All of this is inside the product, so no spreadsheet export is needed. Missing for 10: explicit activity-reporting evidence (only implied via conversation/interaction data), in-depth first-party reporting docs beyond marketing copy, clarity on which plan tier 'Advanced reporting' requires, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
